account-add-favorite.guidance: Record the prior favorite value and send that value after the test.

account-add-to-watchlist.guidance: Record the prior watchlist value and send that value after the test.

authentication-create-session.guidance: Delete the new session ID when the test finishes.

authentication-create-session-from-v4-to.guidance: Delete the converted session ID when the test finishes.

authentication-create-session-from-login.guidance: This validates a temporary request token but does not create a session; let an unused token expire.

authentication-delete-session.guidance: This is the final cleanup for a disposable session and cannot be undone.

list-add-movie.guidance: Check prior membership; remove the movie only if this test added it.

list-clear.guidance: Clearing cannot reconstruct prior membership; use only a list created for the test, then delete it.

list-create.guidance: Delete the list created for the test in a finally block.

list-delete.guidance: Delete only a disposable list because deletion cannot be undone.

list-remove-movie.guidance: Check prior membership; re-add the movie only if it was present before the test.

movie-add-rating.guidance: Restore the prior rating, or delete the new rating if none existed.

movie-delete-rating.guidance: Record and restore a prior rating; if none existed, leave it unrated.

tv-series-add-rating.guidance: Restore the prior rating, or delete the new rating if none existed.

tv-series-delete-rating.guidance: Record and restore a prior rating; if none existed, leave it unrated.

tv-episode-add-rating.guidance: Restore the prior rating, or delete the new rating if none existed.

tv-episode-delete-rating.guidance: Record and restore a prior rating; if none existed, leave it unrated.
